clock_order.consequence: At coincident weekly boundaries, organization collapse is evaluated before that week's recruitment transition.

conditional_recruitment_ignition.available_subcohorts: a_i = ceil(eligible_fraction_i * n), capped at n
conditional_recruitment_ignition.no_success_probability_for_frozen_interv: P(no recruited cohort | state) = exp(-r * dt * sum_i(a_i I_i))
conditional_recruitment_ignition.at_least_one_success: P(ignite | state) = 1 - exp(-H_R), H_R = r * dt * sum_i(a_i I_i)
conditional_recruitment_ignition.note: Identity is conditional on the candidate intensities and cohort availability frozen at that interval boundary.

conditional_collapse.replacement_effect: Recruitment can lower loss_pressure by adding current personnel without adding past cumulative losses; d loss_pressure / dF = -L/(F+L)^2. It also reduces future cohesion erosion through the same loss-pressure term.

resource_boundary.runway_coordinate: Lambda_K = cumulative recruitment-linked capital burn / (initial capital + cumulative inflow)
resource_boundary.capital_failure: Organization collapse rule is triggered at central liquid capital <= 0.

dimensionless_view.ignition_load: H_R relative to H_C determines whether replenishment is likely to occur before repeated weekly collapse opportunities.
dimensionless_view.runway_load: Lambda_K measures whether mobilization has consumed the available liquid-resource runway.
dimensionless_view.window_hypothesis: Increasing r raises ignition probability but also accelerates Lambda_K. A persistent mobilization band can therefore exist between a low-rate stochastic-ignition boundary and a high-rate capital-exhaustion boundary.
